newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Arnotts says first qtr profit falls.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Arnotts says first qtr profit falls.

text.p: Arnotts Ltd said on Thursday that its earnings in the first quarter of 1996/97 were slightly below last year due to continued sluggish economic conditions and low consumer spending levels.
The biscuit maker also told shareholders at the annual general meeting that it expected its full year result would be in line with 1995/96 earnings.

"Unfortunately sluggish economic conditions and stalled consumer spending are continuing to affect the Australian business and this trading pattern is likely to continue throughout the year," Arnotts chairman Duncan McDonald said.

"Our first quarter results reflect this with earnings slightly below last year, notwithstanding these tough trading conditions and the impact of funding the new plant, our earnings for 1996/97 should be in line with last year," McDonald said.
